patch_description: Revert to a single shared parameter "theta" per block (as in the best-performing seed with n_params=8, score=0.80) instead of the two-group split that inflated n_params to 14 and hurt the score. On top of that, inject a parametrized entangling layer using CRZ gates on antipodal qubit pairs, reusing the SAME shared "theta" parameter (no new parameter names introduced), as suggested by the recommendation. This should increase expressivity of the entangling structure beyond pure fixed CZ gates, without any increase in trainable-parameter count, potentially improving accuracy/generalization/convergence while keeping parameter economy at its current best.
